name: opencode-bubble-tabs
description: OpenCode plugin that moves session tabs to the front when they finish or need your input, like iMessage.

scripts.smoke: bun -e "import('./dist/tui.js').then((m) => { if (!m.default?.id || typeof m.default.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('missing V2 CLI plugin export') })" && bun --conditions=import -e "if (typeof require('./dist/gui-experimental.cjs').default?.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('missing GUI plugin export')"
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run smoke
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run prepack && bun run typecheck

author: vimtor
